title: ArborMind CRM
description: Cover slide introducing the ArborMind CRM overview deck (v1.0, May 2026).

title: What ArborMind does
description: Five-point summary of what the CRM captures, tracks, centralizes, and automates, plus an at-a-glance stat block.

title: Core modules
description: Six modules: Leads, Accounts & Contacts, Opportunities, Quotes, Orders, Activities.

title: Quotes & orders
description: Quote features (line items, versions, PDF, send-track, status) and Order features (auto-created on accept, fulfilment, invoicing).

title: Approval workflow
description: Threshold-based governance for quotes, discounts, and orders with tiered approvers and full audit trail.

title: Email & tracking
description: Outbound SMTP send with 1x1 open-tracking pixel and inbound IMAP polling that threads replies to records.

title: AI assistant
description: Next-best-action assistant with seven first-class mutation tools across tasks, calls, stages, owners, email, notes, meetings.

title: System architecture
description: Monorepo, React+Vite frontend, Express API, Postgres+Drizzle, nodemailer SMTP, imapflow IMAP poller.

title: Data model
description: Entity diagram covering Lead, Account, Contact, Opportunity, Quote, Order, Approval, Activity, and EmailTracking.

title: End-to-end flow
description: Ten-step horizontal flow from lead capture through quote, approval, send, accept, order, and close.

title: Process flow — in detail
description: Three-phase breakdown (Pre-sales, Active deal, Fulfilment) with 14 numbered substeps covering actor, action, and system result.

title: Built for arbormind.in
description: Closing slide with live-today scope, what's next, and stack summary.
